items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You mean Irving Smith? Okay, he had this label? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, this was their label.

ctx.x: And you did, in the same old way, what's the B-side?

The B-side was, I'm not the same person I used to be, and this was done by, what is his name, disco, what is his name, the man had the first disco record. Let's go. Yeah, Lil Johnny Taylor. Oh, Jesus. Yeah. Okay, this was a, I will cover on his tune. Uh-huh. I'm not saying, but it's a blues thing. And the other tune I did was Lil Johnny Taylor, the one I was thinking about, I tell you, we didn't finish for Bob Robin. But Bob sold some records on this. Okay. Cinderella, the Cinderella. Cinderella. Now this is…
Yeah. You mean Irving Smith? Okay, he had this label?
